Physics Pro 1.0 brings realistic player and item physics to Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Players can ragdoll from creeper explosions and knockback swords, items can bounce on slime blocks and slide across ice, and accurate block collision boxes make for some really fun interactions. It also works with Actions & Stuff and custom content, with 3D item support for Actions & Stuff planned for the 1.1 update.
